raw_need: Capture veteran expertise before it disappears
validated_need: Convert tacit expert judgments into case-grounded, reproducible decision patterns and quality intent derivations that humans and AI can apply to new cases with explicit cues, concerns, loss boundaries, evidence needs, and governance.
decision_summary: The raw preservation request was reframed from generic know-how capture into a reproducible decision-pattern framework grounded in concrete judgments and bounded by governance.

validation_questions_answered.question: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
validation_questions_answered.answer: Scope: define a domain-general expert judgment framework that extracts tacit judgments from concrete cases, review history, and multi-expert practice, then turns them into reproducible decision patterns, quality intent derivations, and governance artifacts. Out of scope: employee surveillance, blame assignment, generic advice capture, checklist-only reduction, and treating activity counts as quality itself.

validation_questions_answered.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
validation_questions_answered.answer: Success: a non-expert human or AI agent can apply extracted decision patterns to unseen cases with acceptable agreement, explicit cues, concerns, loss boundaries, applicability limits, evidence needs, counterexamples, and governance-based revision.

hidden_assumptions: Veteran expertise can be elicited through abstract explanations alone.
evidence_gaps: Real organizational case corpora and disagreement studies are not yet included in the baseline sample.
